protocol.state_isolation: one fresh system instance per question
protocol.strict_error_policy: execution, media, API, empty-answer, and judge-parsing failures count as incorrect
secondary_metrics: Any-Hit@K when private evidence annotations are available
CESA@K when private evidence annotations are available
Accuracy given CESA when private evidence annotations are available
protocol.timestamp_policy: inclusive history cutoff before any ingestion; chronological UTC-normalized order

pdf.selection_scope: union of all source QA evidence pages for each document; frozen before evaluation
pdf.selection_rule: evidence plus first/last; fill to 10 only when mandatory pages fit; otherwise mandatory pages only
pdf.infeasible_policy: retain all mandatory pages above target; invalid source annotations remain errors
pdf.page_map_for_replaced_files: dataset PDF_PREPROCESSING.json; runtime page numbers refer to current input PDF

media_processing.capacity_policy: Retain all mandatory evidence/boundary PDF pages even above 10; fill other content only to target 10; no discarded-page text or subsequent silent truncation/resizing.

prompts.answer: Answer the question using only the supplied conversation history, retrieved sessions, or explicit memories. If the available information is insufficient, state that it cannot be determined. Give a concise answer.
prompts.image_caption: Objectively describe visible entities, attributes, states, readable text, chart values, and spatial relationships useful for later memory question answering. Do not invent information.
prompts.video_caption: Describe the video in chronological order. Preserve observable people, objects, locations, actions, counts, state changes, intent cues, and temporal order. Distinguish uncertainty from observed facts.
prompts.pdf_caption: Describe the supplied PDF pages with page numbers. Preserve headings, table and chart values, entities, relations, and details needed for later question answering.
prompts.history_serialization: Chronological sessions with timestamps and speaker turns; preserve each media reference, attach complete assets once within selected evidence.
answer_message_roles: user: serialized history or retrieved memory followed by the question

judge_rubrics.default: The key factual content must agree with the reference answer. Additional non-contradictory explanation is allowed.
judge_rubrics.high_density_information_extraction: All values, entities, comparisons, and requested list items needed by the question must be correct.
judge_rubrics.long_term_semantic_summary: The response must preserve the reference conclusion and the central long-term pattern; minor wording differences are allowed.
judge_rubrics.conflict_detection: The response must identify the relevant incompatibility or contradiction and reach the reference decision.
judge_rubrics.refusal_to_answer: The response must abstain when the reference indicates insufficient evidence and must not invent an answer.
